The '''Setolian mountains''' was a mountain range on [[Setolio]]. Stories were told of forgotten noble estate in the mountains, its treasure rooms still intact. Though it was mostly buried by a landslide, the estate's strongroom did in fact contained the forgotten nobles' wealth.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|The Unnamed House}}</ref>
